status: Development-only mechanism gate on the three previously declared sloth interactions.
claim_boundary: This gate may choose whether the method merits a new exploratory cohort run. It is not independent evidence and cannot support a SOTA claim.

source.teacher: released per-edge PhysTwin best checkpoint plus released CMA global parameters

training.video_sampling: 16 uniform frames inside the complete released observation prefix

identity_gate: Every object and controller spring count must match the released checkpoint exactly.
At residual scale zero, exported spring and global parameter tensors must equal the released values exactly.
Repeated identity rollouts must be reported with the Warp replay difference rather than assuming determinism.

development_acceptance_gate.aggregate: Improve both equal-case future CD and track error versus the released Bayesian-PhysTwin selected stack.
development_acceptance_gate.regression: No development case may worsen either future metric by more than 5 percent versus the released selected stack.
development_acceptance_gate.mechanism: The bounded residual must outperform or match the absolute MatPhys v1 head on the double-stretch regression case.
development_acceptance_gate.selection: No future metric may select an epoch, residual scale, or checkpoint.

next_evidence_rule: Run a newly locked exploratory cohort only if every identity and development acceptance condition passes.
